text:
maria_cs: Quick sync — Verdant Health onboarding. I want to confirm SLO acceptance criteria before we send the customer the official SLO summary + evidence bundle. Are we aligned on uptime and latency windows?

nora_pm: Hi — yes, Verdant asked for 99.95% uptime (monthly) and p95 < 120ms for short requests, p99 < 400ms for heavy queries. They also want a simple credits explanation if we miss.

maria_cs: Perfect. Tom, can infra confirm we have the dashboards/screenshots we’ll attach? They want last 30 days + a 7-day focused window.

Tom_SE: I can grab Grafana snapshots. Will include: uptime graph (region: us-west), p95/p99 latency hist, and error rate.

kevin_ops: Also add the rollout logs for model pinning on 2025-02-12 — there was a small latency blip then, good to preempt with notes.

oliver_support: I’ll open the evidence ticket and upload the files. Also adding the incident summary for the blip: low traffic, autoscale lag, mitigated by routing fallback.

maria_cs: Awesome. We need a short SLO explainer paragraph for the customer doc: what triggers credits, how we measure windows, and where they can view live metrics. Anyone want to draft?

amanda_cs: I can draft the paragraph and paste here for review. Suggest one-liner on credits: "If monthly uptime < 99.95%, customer receives pro-rated credit according to SLA table; latency breaches that are transient and not systemic won't automatically trigger credits unless error budget is exhausted." Thoughts?

nora_pm: Sounds right. Add a link to the SLO spec and the SLA credit matrix. Use plain language, avoid engineering jargon.

maria_cs: Thanks. For the evidence bundle checklist (what we attach to the customer):
```
- Grafana 30-day uptime + 7-day zoom
- Latency histograms (p50/p95/p99) for 30d and last 7d
- Request-level sample traces (3 example requests for p99 case)
- Incident summary for any anomalies in window
- Configs: model version pinned, routing policy used
- Runbook excerpt showing fallback behavior
- Contact and escalation path
```

Tom_SE: I’ll export the graphs and anonymize request IDs. Kevin, please confirm the model version string to include (should be v1.3.2-quant).

kevin_ops: Confirmed: v1.3.2-quant pinned for Verdant. Also adding the autoscale policy snippet.

oliver_support: Ticket created: CS-2147. Uploading artifacts now. Link: https://redwood.internal/tickets/CS-2147 (internal only).

maria_cs: Great. Next actions: Amanda to post draft SLO explainer by EOD, Tom to upload screenshots by EOD, Oliver to attach to ticket, Kevin to drop config snippets. I’ll assemble final PDF and send the customer with a short cover note.

deploy-bot: Reminder: scheduled deployment (runtime v2.9) in us-west on 2025-03-02 03:00 UTC — may affect next-window metrics.

maria_cs: Noted. I’ll call that out in the cover note as a potential upcoming variance. Thanks all :thumbsup:

amanda_cs: Draft below — please edit inline: "We measure uptime at the region level (us-west) over a rolling monthly window. Credits are assessed monthly and are pro-rated. Latency SLOs are measured on successful requests only; we publish p95/p99 in the attached charts. For any questions, reply to this thread or reach out to cs-verdant@redwood.com."

nora_pm: LGTM. Add short bullet on how we handle transient spikes and the fallback routing policy.

maria_cs: Final: I’ll assemble and send tomorrow morning. Closing this thread once uploaded to CS-2147. Thanks everyone.
